name: RoutineForge: Routine Planner
description: Visual daily routine planner, habit tracker & focus timer with Nothing OS style, haptic vibration alerts 1 minute before tasks, Picture-in-Picture mode, and home screen widgets.
featureList: Dual-stage vibration alerts (1 min pre-alert + on-time start)
Nothing OS monospace tabular zero-jitter countdown timer
Direct calendar task scheduling by category
Simple continuous focus blocks or structured multi-step routines
Picture-in-Picture (PiP) floating timer and home screen widget
AI-powered semantic search with natural language intent recognition
100% offline, zero advertisements, zero data tracking

faq.name: How does RoutineForge's 1-minute pre-alert vibration work?

acceptedAnswer.text: When scheduling any task or routine in the calendar, RoutineForge uses Android's exact AlarmManager to fire a tactile double-pulse vibration 1 minute before the task starts, followed by an authoritative start alarm on time.

faq.name: Does RoutineForge require internet or user registration?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. RoutineForge is 100% private, offline, and ad-free. All routines and history are stored strictly on your local device.

faq.name: Can I use RoutineForge while watching study videos or gym guides?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. RoutineForge supports native Android Picture-in-Picture (PiP) and an in-app persistent mini player pill so you can multitask freely while your timer ticks down.
